mentions.name: Whispers
mentions.description: A self-organizing, belief-driven mesh in which nodes propose, verify, and evolve solutions through dynamic decentralized consensus. It is implemented as a shared knowledge graph of proposed partial inferences stored in CRDTs, using verification as a merge function. Currently in very early stages, with a cool demo planned.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Whispers is a self-organizing, belief-driven mesh where nodes propose, verify, and evolve solutions through dynamic, decentralized consensus.

Basically a shared knowledge graph of proposed partial inferences in CRDTs using verification as a merge function.
